Jamaat, Shibir emulating ’71 role: Sultana Kamal
2013-12-24T00:00:33+06:00 | Star Online Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/jamaat-shibir-emulating-71-role-sultana-kamal-3797

Transparency International Bangladesh (TIB) chief Sultana Kamal today said Jamaat-e-Islami and its student wing, Islami Chhatra Shibir, are conducting violent activities in a manner similar to that of 1971. Her remarks came in a press conference of Bangladesh Rukhe Darao, a rights organisation, of which she is also the convener, reports the Bangla daily Prothom Alo. The press conference was held to disclose the findings of a seven-member delegation of the organisation that recently visited Satkhira. Activists of Jamaat-Shibir carried out widespread anarchy in the district in recent times during the BNP-led 18-party alliance’s rail, road and waterways blockade. Jamaat-Shibir men are also attacking people of Hindu minority and grassroots activists of Awami League, said Sultana. Human rights are being violated in the existing situation in Satkhira, Sultana insisted, adding that people should voice their demand to ban the politics of Jamaat-Shibir. A total of 45 people have so far been killed in blockade violence in the district, as well as immediately after the International Crimes Tribunal’s (ICT) death sentence against Jamaat leader Delwar Hossain Sayedee, the rights organisation claimed. The seven-member delegation of Bangladesh Rukhe Darao led by senior journalist Abed Khan visited different upazilas of Satkhira from December 22.
